cases.sentence: Они брали их дочерей в жены для себя и своих сыновей, и ___ смешался с иноплеменными народами.
cases.explain: «святой народ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy offspring have mixed themselves with the peoples of the lands. Yes, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.”

cases.sentence: Они брали их дочерей в жены для себя и своих сыновей, и святой народ смешался с ___.
cases.explain: «иноплеменными народами» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy offspring have mixed themselves with the peoples of the lands. Yes, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.”

cases.sentence: А я сидел там, пораженный ужасом, до ___ .
cases.explain: «вечерней жертвы» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel were assembled to me, because of their trespass of the captivity; and I sat confounded until the evening offering.

cases.sentence: Во время ___ я поднялся с места своего самоуничижения в разорванной одежде и накидке, пал на колени, простирая руки к Господу, моему Богу, 6 и стал молиться:
cases.explain: «вечерней жертвы» — after the preposition «во», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: At the evening offering I arose up from my humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn; and I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to Yahweh my God;

cases.sentence: Из-за наших грехов нас и наших царей и священники постигли меч и плен, грабеж и унижения от рук ___, как это есть и по сегодняшний день.
cases.explain: «иноземных царей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests, have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

cases.sentence: Из-за наших грехов нас и наших царей и священники постигли меч и плен, грабеж и унижения от рук иноземных царей, как это есть и по ___.
cases.explain: «сегодняшний день» — after the preposition «по», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests, have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

cases.sentence: Своими ___ они наполнили ее нечистотой от края до края.
cases.explain: «отвратительными обычаями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,

cases.sentence: Никогда не ищите с ними ___, чтобы вам быть сильными и есть блага земли, и оставить ее вашим детям как вечное наследие».
cases.explain: «мирного договора» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Now therefore don’t give your daughters to their sons. Don’t take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity forever; that you may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children forever.’

cases.sentence: После всего, что случилось с нами за наши ___ и великую вину, Ты, Боже наш, наказал нас мягче, чем заслуживали наши грехи, и оставил в живых некоторых из нас.
cases.explain: «злые дела» — after the preposition «за», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “After all that has come on us for our evil deeds, and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such a remnant,

cases.sentence: Неужели мы опять нарушим Твои повеления и будем вступать в родство с народами, которые преданы этим ___?
cases.explain: «отвратительным обычаям» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn’t you be angry with us until you had consumed us, so that there would be no remnant, nor any to escape?
